description: A self-hosted VS Code workbench embedded as an interactive MCP App.
name: io.github.mario-andreschak/mcp-vscode

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the workspace directory exposed through VS Code and MCP tools.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_VSCODE_WORKSPACE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'stream' to opt into experimental genuine-workbench pixel streaming; omit for normal iframe/browser behavior.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_VSCODE_RENDER_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to an installed Edge, Chrome, or Chromium executable used by experimental streaming.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_VSCODE_STREAM_BROWSER

environmentVariables.description: Unsafe container-only escape hatch: set to 1 to launch streaming Chromium without its process sandbox.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_VSCODE_STREAM_NO_SANDBOX

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over standard input and output.
packageArguments.name: --stdio

title: MCP VS Code
